gift.hint: A Gift is a Trait: it says how, and a skill still says what. It never rolls on its own.

athletics.label: Athletics
athletics.hint: Climbing, running, enduring. Also resisting pain.

science.label: Science
science.hint: Biology, chemistry, astronomy, the Greens, analysis.

hullcraft.label: Hullcraft
hullcraft.hint: Repair, engineering, systems; also making things.

procedure.label: Procedure
procedure.hint: Bureaucracy, law, forms, the Checklist. Also resisting bureaucratic pressure.

attune.label: Attune
attune.hint: Sensing, soothing and coaxing the Bound. Also resisting the Bound.

Skill.CostHint: Skills are bought with unspent Tenure. Rating 3 needs Grade III.

Deny.creationMax: At creation, no skill goes above 2.
Deny.creationBudget: That's more than the 12 Tenure creation budget.
Deny.noRefund: Skills can't be lowered once creation is finished. Ask the GM.

Stamps.Label: Stamps
Stamps.Hint: Earned when any Encumbrance bites, sometimes from a Margin of Grace, and for withdrawing from a scene. Spend: Expedite (+1 die), Countersign (give to an ally's roll), Reclassify (downgrade a Notice as it lands), Cite a Clause, Amend the Scene.
Stamps.CitePrompt: Which rule do you declare exists and applies here?
Stamps.CiteNote: Binding, and it helps. The GM adds one detail of how it actually reads.
Stamps.SessionHint: Stamps up to what your Grade begins each session with: 2, and one more at Grades III, VI and IX.

Tenure.Label: Tenure
Tenure.Hint: Spent on skills and Traits. Grade follows Tenure earned, never what you've spent.

Scrutiny.Label: Scrutiny
Scrutiny.Hint: The ship pushes back. The GM gains 1 whenever a Margin comes up as an Error, and spends it on complications.
Scrutiny.ShowHint: A small window showing the GM's Scrutiny to everyone at the table.

Track.Heading: Notices
Track.ClearMinorsHint: End of session: clear all Minor Notices.
Track.Overflowed: The track was full: the Notice escalated.
Track.ClearsByHint: blank = the default for its type
Track.TreatHint: Treated: this Notice is dealt with and its box clears.
Track.Escalate: Both Minor boxes are full. This Notice escalates to a Major. Continue?
Track.EscalateOut: Both Minor boxes and both Major boxes are full. This Notice takes you out of the scene (Final). Continue?

Npc.RatingHint: Used directly as the Difficulty of any roll against this NPC, or to resist them. 1 ordinary, 2 tough, 3 nemesis, 4 reserved.
Npc.TagsHint: What they are good at. When a Tag applies, the player loses a die.

NpcTier.backgroundHint: Toughs, crowds, clerks: any Notice takes them out.
NpcTier.minorHint: One Minor box; the next Notice, or any Major, takes them out.
NpcTier.majorHint: A full Notice track like a PC; can Withdraw.

Pool.Title: Build a Pool
Pool.GiftNote: Adds a die and turns up to two dice violet.
Pool.EnvironmentHint: Circumstances: gear, a scene Trait, a PC assisting, a form filed in advance. Obstacles: wind, wet rock, darkness, a relevant NPC Tag or a Notice on you. Bound dice replace white dice; they never add to the pool.
Pool.ExpediteNote: Spend a Stamp for +1 die. One per roll.
Pool.EncumbranceNote: If any Encumbrance is in play, the Margin of Error widens to 1–2 and an Error earns a Stamp. Encumbrances never add dice.

SceneSource.token: Your token is on this card. Change it if that's wrong.
SceneSource.active: Using the active scene. Change it if you're somewhere else.
SceneSource.none: No scene found. Pick one if it applies.

Pool.NoTraits: Fill in Station and your Traits on the sheet to use them here.
Pool.CommendationHint: Tick a Commendation when its situation applies.

Roll.Floored: Pool reduced to the Margin alone.
Roll.GraceText: Something goes unexpectedly right: a detail, a helping hand, or a Stamp.
Roll.ErrorText: A twist. The GM introduces a complication.
Roll.ResonanceText: The Bound notice. Something sings back.
Roll.MarginTarget: The Margin succeeds on {n}+ at this Grade.
Roll.UpgradeNote: A Commendation turns With Conditions into Approved.
Roll.ImpossibleNote: {name}: the GM allows the normally impossible.

Card.ActiveHint: The active scene: where everyone falls back to when their token isn't standing on a card.
Card.DescriptionPlaceholder: What it looks, sounds and smells like.
Card.TraitsHint: Environmental dice for anyone here. Obstacles (−1) apply unless unticked; Circumstances (+1) are opt-in, for anyone who can plausibly use them.
Card.AmendHint: Amend the Scene: spend a Stamp to declare a new Trait (a steam pipe bursts, useful scrap turns up, a hatch was unlocked all along). Worth +1 die to anyone who can plausibly use it; the GM may add one small detail.
Card.AmendNote: Worth +1 die to anyone who can plausibly use it. The GM may add one small detail.
Card.TraitNote: A note on how it works (optional)
Card.AutoHint: Ticked by default in the roll dialog. Players can still untick it.
Card.HiddenHint: Hidden from players until you untick this.
Card.NoCharacter: You need a character to spend a Stamp. Select your token first.
Card.NoGM: A GM has to be online to add a Trait.

Traits.BuyHint: A new open Trait slot (maximum six).
Traits.BuyBody: A new open Trait costs {cost} Tenure. Buy it?

Deny.max: You already have six open Traits.
Deny.needTenure: A new open Trait costs 4 Tenure.

Grade.Label: Grade
Grade.Hint: Set by lifetime Tenure earned: every 6 Tenure earns the next Grade. Grade sets your Stamps per session, the Margin's success threshold, and your Commendation slots, and unlocks skill rating 3 at Grade III.
Grade.ReachedNote: Seniority is the ship's real wealth.

Creation.Label: Creation
Creation.Hint: 12 Tenure to buy skills, maximum rating 2. The standard spread is three skills at 2 and three at 1.
Creation.FinishBody: After this, skills are bought with Tenure you earn, and can't be lowered. Station, Traits and Encumbrances stay editable.

Encumbrance.Heading: Encumbrances
Encumbrance.Hint: Two troubles. If any is in play, the Margin of Error widens to 1–2 and an Error earns a Stamp. They never add dice.
Encumbrance.personalPrompt: a flaw (Can't Leave a Machine Unfixed)
Encumbrance.circumstantialPrompt: an obligation or situation (Censured Once, Watched Ever Since)

Gift.Heading: Gift and Drawback
Gift.Hint: Touched gifts are small, specific and quiet: useful, inconvenient, and occasionally both. A Gift adds its die and turns up to two dice violet. Its Drawback works as a third Encumbrance.
Gift.DrawbackHint: The inconvenient side of the same Gift.
Gift.DrawbackPrompt: the other side (Hears Them When They're Hurting)
Gift.DrawbackNote: In play, the Drawback is an Encumbrance: it widens the Margin of Error and earns a Stamp.
Gift.RegisteredHint: Being unregistered makes a good circumstantial Encumbrance.

Commendation.Heading: Commendations
Commendation.Hint: Because I [short phrase], when [specific situation], I [one rule-break]. Slots come at Grades II, V and VIII.
Commendation.SituationPlaceholder: when I Hullcraft against the clock
Commendation.difficulty: Treat the Difficulty as one lower

History.Heading: History
History.Q2: Did you learn something Chorus didn't tell you?
History.Q3: Did you bend a rule that should have held?

Ledger.Title: Ledger
Ledger.Search: Search the ledger: a name, a place, a word…
Ledger.Empty: Nothing under that name. Try fewer letters.
Ledger.ImportHint: Make an NPC for every person and a Scene Card for every place. Anything already imported is left alone.

Lore.GMOnly: Only a GM can import the lore.
Lore.Missing: The lore bundle isn't installed. Install a release of the system: it ships with the ledger entries.
Lore.Imported: Imported {created} new, {existing} already in the world.
